import copy
import unittest

from solution import apply_form_actions


class ApplyFormActionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_actions_are_applied_in_order(self):
        initial = {"name": "old", "meta": {"tags": ["a"]}, "keep": 0}
        actions = [
            {"op": "set", "field": "name", "value": "new"},
            {"op": "copy", "source": "meta", "target": "backup"},
            {"op": "remove", "field": "meta"},
            {"op": "require", "field": "name"},
            {"op": "require", "field": "keep"},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            apply_form_actions(initial, actions),
            {"name": "new", "keep": 0, "backup": {"tags": ["a"]}},
        )

    def test_empty_actions_returns_deep_copy(self):
        initial = {"nested": {"items": [1, 2]}}
        result = apply_form_actions(initial, [])
        self.assertEqual(result, initial)
        self.assertIsNot(result, initial)
        self.assertIsNot(result["nested"], initial["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["nested"]["items"], initial["nested"]["items"])

    def test_set_and_copy_values_are_deeply_independent(self):
        caller_value = {"items": [[1]]}
        initial = {"source": caller_value}
        actions = [
            {"op": "set", "field": "set_value", "value": caller_value},
            {"op": "copy", "source": "source", "target": "copied"},
        ]
        result = apply_form_actions(initial, actions)
        result["set_value"]["items"][0].append(2)
        result["copied"]["items"][0].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(caller_value, {"items": [[1]]})
        self.assertEqual(result["source"], {"items": [[1]]})
        self.assertEqual(result["set_value"], {"items": [[1, 2]]})
        self.assertEqual(result["copied"], {"items": [[1, 3]]})

    def test_require_rejects_only_missing_none_and_empty_string(self):
        for value in (0, False, [], {}):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertEqual(
                    apply_form_actions({"field": value}, [{"op": "require", "field": "field"}]),
                    {"field": value},
                )
        for initial in ({}, {"field": None}, {"field": ""}):
            with self.subTest(initial=initial):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    apply_form_actions(initial, [{"op": "require", "field": "field"}])

    def test_missing_remove_copy_source_and_same_copy_names_fail(self):
        bad_actions = [
            {"op": "remove", "field": "missing"},
            {"op": "copy", "source": "missing", "target": "x"},
            {"op": "copy", "source": "x", "target": "x"},
        ]
        for action in bad_actions:
            with self.subTest(action=action):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    apply_form_actions({"x": 1}, [action])

    def test_malformed_inputs_and_exact_shapes(self):
        cases = [
            ([], []),
            ({1: "bad key"}, []),
            ({}, None),
            ({}, ["set"]),
            ({}, [{}]),
            ({}, [{"op": "unknown", "field": "x"}]),
            ({}, [{"op": "set", "field": "x"}]),
            ({}, [{"op": "set", "field": "x", "value": 1, "extra": 2}]),
            ({}, [{"op": "remove", "field": "",}]),
            ({}, [{"op": "require", "field": 1}]),
            ({"x": 1}, [{"op": "copy", "source": "x"}]),
            ({"x": 1}, [{"op": "copy", "source": "x", "target": "y", "extra": 1}]),
        ]
        for initial, actions in cases:
            with self.subTest(initial=initial, actions=actions):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    apply_form_actions(initial, actions)

    def test_later_failure_leaves_inputs_unchanged(self):
        initial = {"nested": {"values": [1]}}
        supplied = {"new": [2]}
        actions = [
            {"op": "set", "field": "added", "value": supplied},
            {"op": "remove", "field": "missing"},
        ]
        before_initial = copy.deepcopy(initial)
        before_actions = copy.deepcopy(actions)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply_form_actions(initial, actions)
        self.assertEqual(initial, before_initial)
        self.assertEqual(actions, before_actions)
        self.assertEqual(supplied, {"new": [2]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
